title: Spain Aragon Crop fields
description: Official field boundaries for the Aragon region of Spain, derived from the SIGPAC geographic information system coordinated with the land registry. Contains 4,146,895 parcels with crop classification and administrative codes, converted to fiboa GeoParquet format from data published by the Gobierno de Aragón.
readme:
## README.md
# Field boundaries for Spain Aragon

Provides 4146895 official field boundaries from Spain Aragon.
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from data obtained from Gobierno de Aragorn.

- **Source Data Provider:** [Gobierno de Aragorn](https://www.aragon.es/)
- **Converted by:** Ivor Bosloper
- **License:** CC-BY-4.0 see https://idearagon.aragon.es/portal/politica-privacidad.jsp
- **Projection:** EPSG:25830

---

- [Download the data as fiboa GeoParquet](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-ar/es_ar.parquet)
- [STAC Browser](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/data.source.coop/fiboa/es-ar/stac/collection.json)
- [STAC Collection](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-ar/stac/collection.json)
- [PMTiles](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-ar/es_ar.pmtiles)

## Columns

| Property                | **Data Type** | Description |
|-------------------------|---------------|-------------|
| id                      | string        |             |
| admin_province_code     | string        |             |
| admin_municipality_code | string        |             |
| crop:code               | string        |             |
| crop:name               | string        |             |
| crop:name_en            | string        |             |
| determination_datetime  | timestamp     |             |
| admin:country_code      | string        |             |
| crop:code_list          | string        |             |
| admin:subdivision_code  | string        |             |

## Lineage

- Data downloaded on 2024-12-24 from:
  - https://icearagon.aragon.es/datosdescarga/descarga.php?file=/CartoTema/sigpac/rec22_sigpac.shp.zip
  - https://icearagon.aragon.es/datosdescarga/descarga.php?file=/CartoTema/sigpac/rec44_sigpac.shp.zip
  - https://icearagon.aragon.es/datosdescarga/descarga.php?file=/CartoTema/sigpac/rec50_sigpac.shp.zip
- Converted to GeoParquet using [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli), version 0.8.0
